name: phone-sign-in
title: Phone sign-in
description: Sign in with a phone number: a country code and number checked on blur, a text with a code, then six boxes with resend and a way to change the number.
docs: onRequestCode(phone) receives the number in the international form, +31612345678 (the phone field's own output), and resolves whether or not the number has an account; reject only when the request itself failed. The first step catches a number that cannot be right when the field is left and again on submit, with the shape it should have in words (Enter a Dutch number: 9 digits after +31, like 6 12 34 56 78 for the eight countries of the field, a length rule for any other); phoneProblem and formatPhone are exported from phone-sign-in/phone. Step two shows the number as +31 6 12 34 56 78 with Change number (which also stops the resend wait and clears what was last said), and codeLength boxes (default 6): the first asks the phone to offer the code from the message, pasting fills them all, and the last digit calls onVerify(code), which resolves true (sign in and navigate) or false: a wrong code is announced once, the boxes are cleared and the first has the focus. Resend code waits resendAfter seconds (default 30), counting down in tabular figures from timestamps, and speaks only when the wait starts and when it ends. smsNotice is the optional line about message rates, onUseEmail adds Use email instead, defaultCountry and countries go to the phone field. defaultPhone, defaultSent, defaultError and defaultCodeError set the start for previews; footer, titleAs and labels work as in the other auth cards.
